Implication: JWT IdP accepted a token with wrong aud (signature verified but semantic audience binding not enforced).

finding.sequence_description: JWT IdP freshness + replay window: control JWT with exp/iat accepted; attack JWT omits exp and is submitted twice via two separate idp intents. Missing exp should be rejected; if accepted, it can be replayed indefinitely.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: jwt_i2_attack1_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_i2_attack1_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT missing exp was accepted for federated login (expiry check bypass).

sequence.description: JWT IdP freshness + replay window: control JWT with exp/iat accepted; attack JWT omits exp and is submitted twice via two separate idp intents. Missing exp should be rejected; if accepted, it can be replayed indefinitely.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: JWTs used for federated login must enforce expiry; a token missing exp must be rejected, and must not be reusable beyond its intended lifetime.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control JWT with exp+iat should be accepted and produce a retrievable IdP intent.

Assertion FAILED: jwt_iat_attack_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: jwt_iat_attack_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT missing iat was accepted — freshness window can be bypassed, enabling replay of arbitrarily old tokens.

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: JWT IdP must require iat (and enforce freshness window); omitting iat must be rejected to prevent replay of arbitrarily old tokens.

finding.sequence_description: JWT IdP: baseline JWT with correct issuer and temporal claims is accepted, then an otherwise-valid JWT with wrong aud is submitted. If accepted, audience binding is not enforced and authorization can be granted outside upstream intent.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_jwt_wrong_aud_login_http_status >= 400 OR attack_retrieve_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_jwt_wrong_aud_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (attack_retrieve_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: JWT with wrong aud was accepted, indicating missing audience binding and potential authorization beyond UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.

sequence.description: JWT IdP: baseline JWT with correct issuer and temporal claims is accepted, then an otherwise-valid JWT with wrong aud is submitted. If accepted, audience binding is not enforced and authorization can be granted outside upstream intent.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bound to the intended audience. A JWT with an incorrect aud must be rejected; otherwise the broker may grant authorization to unintended relying parties.
